pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with a CHECK. test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks the three seeded rows are 0 and that done=2 is rejected.
src/index.js defaults view to open and filters WHERE done = 0 ORDER BY id. 'AC-2' checks / and /?view=open after marking item 2 done.
The done view filters done = 1, and item() adds the ✓ prefix. 'AC-3' marks 3 then 1 and expects the ✓ items in id order.
The all view has no filter. 'AC-4' expects all three items in id order with only the done one marked.
nav() renders the current view as <strong> and the others as links. 'AC-5' asserts the exact nav HTML for each view and for /.
Object.hasOwn(VIEWS, current) guards the view and answers 400 with no list. 'AC-6' covers Open, closed, empty string and __proto__.
The empty-table check falls back to 'No items yet.' when COUNT is 0. 'AC-7' covers Nothing open, Nothing done yet and an empty table in all three views.
traffic/routes.json lists /?view=done and /?view=all. 'AC-8' imports the file and checks both. traffic-config-check.mjs now accepts a query string, and the shell test covers it.

findings.what: AC-8 only checks that routes.json contains the two strings. No test shows the traffic Worker requests a query route with its query intact. The only traffic-test change is to the fake app, which now records the query.
findings.fix: Add a test in test/traffic.test.js that runs a round with the real ROUTES and asserts the fake app saw /?view=done and /?view=all.

lenses.note: The change follows the spec's decisions: it opens on open items and the view is a query parameter. Nothing in the diff adds a write route or a cookie.
All 8 acceptance items and all 6 state rows have tests. Neither commit edits the spec after the go.

The tests assert behaviour. No test was deleted or loosened. The existing index tests still hold under the open default, since the seeded items are all open. `npm test` could not run here because vitest is not installed, and CI runs the tests on every push.
README describes the views. The traffic section needs no change.
The view value is validated with Object.hasOwn. The SQL fragments are constants and nothing user-supplied reaches the query. The extra COUNT query runs only when a non-all view is empty.
The only new input is the view parameter, which is whitelisted. Titles are still HTML-escaped. The traffic route regex now allows ? but still refuses spaces and #.
The diff changes src/index.js, which renders the page HTML. The nav is plain and the current view is not a link.
The page has a UI. The PR gives no browser session or screenshots, and the tests cover the rendered HTML.
The claims match the diff, including the 400 on other view values, the traffic-check change and the fake-app change. The title is under 72 characters.
